command:
set -eu
cp -p /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.pre-mount-hardening
awk '$2 != "/tmp" && $2 != "/dev/shm" { print }' /etc/fstab > /etc/fstab.new
printf '%s\n' 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777 0 0' 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777 0 0' >> /etc/fstab.new
chmod 644 /etc/fstab.new
mv /etc/fstab.new /etc/fstab
mount -t tmpfs -o rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777 tmpfs /tmp
mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777 /dev/shm
printf '%s\n' '--- fstab ---'; cat /etc/fstab

command:
set -u
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- mount records ---'; awk '$2=="/tmp" || $2=="/dev/shm" {print}' /proc/mounts
printf '%s\n' '--- behavioral probes ---'
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  cp /bin/true "$d/antrieb-exec-test"
  chmod 755 "$d/antrieb-exec-test"
  if "$d/antrieb-exec-test" 2>"$d/exec.err"; then printf '%s execution=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n' "$d"; else rc=$?; printf '%s execution=blocked rc=%s error=' "$d" "$rc"; tr '\n' ' ' < "$d/exec.err"; printf '\n'; fi
  rm -f "$d/antrieb-exec-test" "$d/exec.err"
  rm -f "$d/antrieb-dev-test"
  mknod "$d/antrieb-dev-test" c 1 3
  if dd if="$d/antrieb-dev-test" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 2>"$d/dev.err"; then printf '%s device=UNEXPECTEDLY_USABLE\n' "$d"; else rc=$?; printf '%s device=blocked rc=%s error=' "$d" "$rc"; tr '\n' ' ' < "$d/dev.err"; printf '\n'; fi
  rm -f "$d/antrieb-dev-test" "$d/dev.err"
  printf 'persistence-probe-%s\n' "$d" > "$d/antrieb-data-probe"
  printf '%s data=' "$d"; cat "$d/antrieb-data-probe"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- services ---'; rc-status default
printf '%s\n' '--- persistent config ---'; grep -E '^[^#].*[[:space:]]/(tmp|dev/shm)[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab

command:
boot_before=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; /sbin/reboot' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
printf 'reboot_scheduled node=%s boot_before=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$boot_before"

boot_before=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; /sbin/reboot' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
printf 'reboot_scheduled node=%s boot_before=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$boot_before"

set -u
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- persistent config ---'; grep -E '^[^#].*[[:space:]]/(tmp|dev/shm)[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' '--- mount option assertions ---'
fail=0
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  line=$(awk -v p="$d" '$2==p {print; exit}' /proc/mounts)
  printf '%s mount=%s\n' "$d" "$line"
  opts=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | awk '{print $4}')
  for opt in nosuid nodev noexec; do
    case ",$opts," in *,$opt,*) printf '%s %s=yes\n' "$d" "$opt";; *) printf '%s %s=NO\n' "$d" "$opt"; fail=1;; esac
  done
done
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart behavioral probes ---'
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  printf 'post-restart-write-read-%s\n' "$d" > "$d/antrieb-data-probe"
  printf '%s data=' "$d"; cat "$d/antrieb-data-probe"
  cp /bin/true "$d/antrieb-exec-test"; chmod 755 "$d/antrieb-exec-test"
  if "$d/antrieb-exec-test" 2>"$d/exec.err"; then printf '%s execution=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n' "$d"; fail=1; else rc=$?; printf '%s execution=blocked rc=%s error=' "$d" "$rc"; tr '\n' ' ' < "$d/exec.err"; printf '\n'; fi
  rm -f "$d/antrieb-exec-test" "$d/exec.err" "$d/antrieb-dev-test"
  mknod "$d/antrieb-dev-test" c 1 3
  if dd if="$d/antrieb-dev-test" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 2>"$d/dev.err"; then printf '%s device=UNEXPECTEDLY_USABLE\n' "$d"; fail=1; else rc=$?; printf '%s device=blocked rc=%s error=' "$d" "$rc"; tr '\n' ' ' < "$d/dev.err"; printf '\n'; fi
  rm -f "$d/antrieb-dev-test" "$d/dev.err" "$d/antrieb-data-probe"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- directory modes ---'; ls -ld /tmp /dev/shm
printf '%s\n' '--- recovered services ---'; rc-status default
exit "$fail"
